title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Strawberry Raspberry Cherry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Strawberry Raspberry Cherry combines three distinct red fruit flavours into a rich, vibrant and well-balanced vape. The soft sweetness of ripe Strawberries blends seamlessly with the tangy burst of Raspberry and the deep, rich notes of Cherry, creating a flavour-packed inhale with a satisfying fruit-laced exhale. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid delivers a consistently smooth throat hit with optimised nicotine absorption. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio ensures rich flavour clarity and discreet vapour production, making it an excellent choice for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, bringing familiar and satisfying flavours to a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
